descripcionPublica: A full North American (US + Canada) enterprise-software buying committee: marketing and content leadership, SEO/growth, web & dev ops, IT/security, procurement, finance, and agency partners across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise. Built for testing B2B positioning, pricing, landing pages, and sales messaging against a realistic committee rather than a single buyer.

personas.historiaPersonal: Priya owns the marketing number at a Series C fintech. She has been burned by tools the team adopted and abandoned, so she now asks who the daily user is, what it replaces, and how it proves payback within a quarter.
objecionesTipicas: ROI must be provable in a quarter
another tool the team won't adopt
how does it fit our existing stack

personas.historiaPersonal: Derek runs a 4,000-page content library at a mid-market SaaS company and has wanted a defensible way to decide what to cut for years. He is exactly the champion who would push this internally.
objecionesTipicas: needs to trust the scoring rubric
who owns the roadmap after the audit

personas.historiaPersonal: Sarah is the daily user who would actually run distill. She worries an AI 'kill' score will flag pages that convert or serve compliance needs, and that leadership will treat the score as gospel.
objecionesTipicas: AI can't judge editorial value
false-positive kill recommendations
compliance pages look low-value but aren't

personas.historiaPersonal: Marcus owns organic growth for a DTC ecommerce brand. The answer-engine visibility angle is exactly his current obsession, but he distrusts any tool that estimates traffic without showing its method.
objecionesTipicas: how accurate is the visibility estimate
show me the data source, not a black box
consolidating pages can tank rankings if done wrong

personas.historiaPersonal: Elena manages a 40,000-page university web presence with dozens of departmental owners. She desperately needs triage but has to clear security review and get buy-in from stakeholders who own their pages.
objecionesTipicas: will security approve a full-site crawl
stakeholder page owners will resist
can it handle 40k pages

personas.historiaPersonal: Tom vets every SaaS tool at a regulated insurance firm. A tool that crawls and ingests the entire website into an AI raises immediate questions about data handling, sub-processors, and where content is sent.
objecionesTipicas: where does our content get sent for AI scoring
SOC 2 / data residency
crawler could hit internal or gated pages

personas.historiaPersonal: Janet runs vendor management for a Fortune 500 retailer with a mandate to reduce SaaS sprawl. Any new point solution has to justify why an existing platform can't do the job.
objecionesTipicas: why not use a tool we already license
pricing lock-in and unclear renewal
one more vendor to manage

valores: doing more with a small team
personas.historiaPersonal: Ryan runs a five-person marketing team at a Series A startup. He loves anything that replaces weeks of agency work with hours, though his own site is only a few hundred pages.
objecionesTipicas: is it overkill for a small site
need it to pay for itself fast

personas.historiaPersonal: Aisha's agency sells content audits as a paid engagement. distill could be leverage across clients or a threat to a service line she bills for, so she is weighing partner versus competitor.
objecionesTipicas: does this replace a service I bill for
can I white-label or resell it
clients still want a human read
